مُسَيَّفٌ , applied to a [garment of the kind called] بُرْد, Having upon it what resemble the forms of سُيُوف [or swords]: (M, TA:) and, so applied, having broad stripes, like the سَيْف [or sword]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And applied to a dirhem, of which the sides are plain, or clear of any impress or the like. (IAar, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
